title: Delivery Claims Charge-Back Schedule: Returned Items, Found Parcels and Recovery
content:
Finance recovery schedule for Delivery Claims: whether the item received must be sent back, the windows for sending back a wrong item or a parcel that turns up after compensation, what is charged when it is not, and how value is recovered.

| Claim type | Item received must be sent back with a prepaid label | Window to send it back (calendar days after approval) | Charged when a required item is not sent back | Parcel that turns up after compensation | Window to send a found parcel back (calendar days after it turns up) | Recovery taken by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Late Delivery Claim | no | 0 (not required) | not applicable | not applicable | 0 (not applicable) | charge to the original card |
| Delivered Not Received Claim | no | 0 (not required) | not applicable | sent back with a prepaid label, or charged | 14 | charge to the original card |
| Lost in Transit Claim | no | 0 (not required) | not applicable | sent back with a prepaid label, or charged | 14 | charge to the original card |
| Damaged in Transit Claim | no | 0 (not required) | not applicable | not applicable | 0 (not applicable) | charge to the original card |
| Missing Item Claim | no | 0 (not required) | not applicable | not applicable | 0 (not applicable) | charge to the original card |
| Wrong Item Claim | yes | 14 | the net price of the item kept | not applicable | 0 (not applicable) | charge to the original card |

## How the schedule reads

- Only the Wrong Item Claim requires the item received to be sent back: within 14 calendar days after approval, with a prepaid label.
- Only the Delivered Not Received Claim and the Lost in Transit Claim carry found-parcel terms: a parcel compensated as undelivered that turns up is sent back with a prepaid label within 14 calendar days after it turns up, or the customer is charged.
- Every recovery under Delivery Claims is charged to the original card.
